entries.title: I Chronicles 29:1
segments: And David the king said unto all the assembly, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Jehovah God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:2
segments: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the [things of] gold, and the silver for the [things of] silver, and the brass for the [things of] brass, the iron for the [things of] iron, and wood for the [things of] wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, stones for inlaid work, and of divers colors, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:3
segments: Moreover also, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, seeing that I have a treasure of mine own of gold and silver, I give it unto the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:4
segments: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, wherewith to overlay the walls of the houses;

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:5
segments: of gold for the [things of] gold, and of silver for the [things of] silver, and for all manner of work [to be made] by the hands of artificers. Who then offereth willingly to consecrate himself this day unto Jehovah?

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:6
segments: Then the princes of the fathers' [houses], and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king's work, offered willingly;

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:7
segments: and they gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:8
segments: And they with whom [precious] stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of Jehovah, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:9
segments: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Jehovah: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:10
segments: Wherefore David blessed Jehovah before all the assembly; and David said, Blessed be thou, O Jehovah, the God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:11
segments: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth [is thine]; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:12
segments: Both riches and honor come of thee, and thou rulest over all; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:13
segments: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:14
segments: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:15
segments: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:16
segments: O Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name cometh of thy hand, and is all thine own.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:17
segments: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, that are present here, offer willingly unto thee.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:18
segments: O Jehovah, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee;

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:19
segments: and give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:20
segments: And David said to all the assembly, Now bless Jehovah your God. And all the assembly blessed Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped Jehovah, and the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:21
segments: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:22
segments: and did eat and drink before Jehovah on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto Jehovah to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:23
segments: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:24
segments: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:25
segments: And Jehovah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:26
segments: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:27
segments: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three [years] reigned he in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:28
segments: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:29
segments: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:30
segments: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
